authority: founder act, 2026-09-22 — 'the successfully production-tested instrument should now be frozen by exact blob hash'; REVIEW-CUSTODY-01 / S3 Class-B freeze precedent
law: These are the exact bytes that ran against production on 2026-09-22 and produced I5-P0 READY. Changing any of them changes what was tested. A repair, a convenience, a refactor or a rerun against a different substrate requires a NEW instrument at a NEW address with its own authorization — never an edit to these.
additive_law_permitted: New instruments may be ADDED at their own address. Adding never edits a frozen file; the blob hash is the mechanical test.
why_these_three: The remediation act mutated production configuration; the two seam witnesses are the property-bound gate it consulted before and after. The remediation script already hard-codes and verifies its two siblings' blob hashes before use, so the instrument was self-binding downward. Nothing bound the remediation script's own bytes. This manifest closes that, at the instrument's own address.

note: Blob hashes, not a commit diff: blob identity survives history rewriting and names exactly which bytes are law.
